```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a scatter plot to visualize the relationship between Sleep Duration and Quality of Sleep
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.scatterplot(data=data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', hue='BMI Category', style='Gender', size='Physical Activity Level', sizes=(20, 200), alpha=0.7)

# Add axis labels and title
plt.xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
plt.title('Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category and Gender')

# Add legend
plt.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
